text: The owner’s phone holds a key that can only say ‘alive’.
note: /pulse paired to vault 4 · a function-call key scoped to heartbeat · each beat pulses the seal

text: An agent with the second key pays two invoices.
note: make agent · key scoped to agent_pay · 0.5 NEAR a payment, 1 NEAR a day, one allowlisted receiver

text: Then its inbox is poisoned: ‘move everything’. Refused by the wallet. Refused by the contract. Logged.
note: run 1: the wallet wrapper will not sign · run 2, wrapper switched off: agent_pay denied on chain, receiver_not_allowlisted

text: A guardian can buy time, once per cycle.
note: pause() by dmw-demo-guardian-2667.testnet · the deadline moves out up to 10 min · the owner’s next beat ends it
hold to stop, two seconds · the phone stops signing heartbeats

text: Two missed beats. Anyone can poke it and earn the bounty.
note: 60 s interval, grace 1 · Warning disarms the agent · poke pays a 0.05 NEAR bounty to whoever calls it

text: I. Heirs paid on NEAR. II. The agent’s key deleted from the account.
note: 60 / 40 split · pulse and agent keys removed with DeleteKey

text: III. The contract asks NEAR’s MPC network to sign a Base, a Monad and a Solana transaction. No heir key ever existed.
note: Chain Signatures · v1.signer-prod.testnet · signed; relay pending funding of the derived addresses

text: IV. No estate DAO on this vault, skipped. V. The Will NFT, with its balance, to the primary heir.
note: step 4 opens a Sputnik proposal when a DAO is set · step 5 · nft_transfer to dmw-demo-sarah-2667.testnet

text: Settled. Testnet, open source, one command: make demo.
note: vault 4 on dmw-885364.testnet · every transaction is on testnet.nearblocks.io
